parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the toggle switches of the wall switch assembly, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that allows the user to turn the electrical circuit on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or linearly within a small range to change the circuit state.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second toggle switch of the wall switch assembly, also made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional control point for a separate electrical circuit or light.
parts.Movement_description: It moves similarly to the first switch, toggling between on and off positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base plate or body of the wall switch, typically made of stainless steel or metal alloy.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components, securing the switches in place.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall surface.
